name: Virtual Comic Reader
summary:
Bring your own DRM-free publications into Virtual Comic Reader and make space for reading on Meta Quest.

Read CBR, CBZ and PDF files with single-page or two-page views, right-to-left manga reading, bookmarks, favorites and saved progress. Organize your library into collections, adjust the reading view, and choose a virtual library or a distraction-free black environment. The included guide helps you get started.

Import your files with Send to VcR. Turn eligible comic, magazine and manga pages into jigsaw
